get.description:
Liveness for uptime pings and the host's health check. Never touches the database, so a serverless
database can still suspend while the app is idle.
Start signing in with GitHub: redirects there, and GitHub sends the visitor back to the callback.
What the web app needs at start-up.

Your recent conversations, most recent first: when signed in, from every device and kept for longer;
otherwise this session's.
The answered messages of one of your conversations, oldest first, to pick it up again.

schema.title: Response Conversation V1 Conversations  Conversation Id  Messages Get

post.description:
Ask a question. With `Accept: text/event-stream` the answer streams as events: `message` (its id),
`step` as each step finishes, `table`, `chart`, `token` (summary text: add it, or with `replace` use it
instead of everything so far), and `done` with the whole message; or `error` with a problem object.
Otherwise the response is the finished message as JSON.

get.description: The review queue, and what is approved but not yet in the library.

post.description: Open a draft pull request adding the approved answers to semantic/queries.yml, where CI checks them.

get.description: The approved answers as entries to paste at the end of semantic/queries.yml.

post.description:
Approve or reject a queued answer. Approving keeps it for the next export; nothing changes what the
analyst does until that pull request is merged.

get.description: Your uploaded files that haven't expired, newest first (none before you have a session).

schema.title: Response List Datasets V1 Datasets Get

post.description:
Upload a CSV file (by default up to 5 MB, 200,000 rows and 60 columns) to ask questions about it, by
sending its id as `dataset_id` with each question. It is kept for a day. Personal data such as email
addresses and phone numbers is found and never shown in answers.

Import a Google Sheet shared by link, as if its tab were an uploaded CSV file (same limits, kept for a
day). Only Google's own hosts are contacted.
Import an imported sheet again, keeping the dataset's id (and its conversations) and another day.

get.description:
The latest complete week's most notable moves in the data, found nightly (app/jobs/insights.py), each
with its figures, the query behind them and a question to look into it. Empty before the first run.
Your API keys that still work, oldest first, without the keys themselves.

schema.title: Response List Keys V1 Keys Get

post.description:
Make an API key. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` to ask as yourself, under your own question
limits. The key is in this response only: store it somewhere safe.

delete.description: Revoke a key. Requests made with it are refused from now on.

get.description: Who is signed in, if anyone.

post.description: The answer's query as plain-English steps. Worked out once, then kept.
Rate an answer. Rating again replaces the earlier rating.

Share one of your answers: a read-only snapshot anyone with the link (/s/{id}) can open, without
signing in. Sharing the same answer again gives the same link.

get.description: Your latest reports, newest first, without their bodies.

schema.title: Response List Reports V1 Reports Get

post.description:
Start a report on a broad question. It runs for a minute or two: poll GET /v1/reports/{id}. One report at
a time per user, and a few a day.

get.description: A report: its progress while it runs, and the report once it is done.

post.description: Issue a visitor session cookie, after the Turnstile bot check when it is on.

delete.description: Stop sharing: the link stops working for everyone.

get.description: A shared answer. Anyone with the link can read it; nothing is run again.
